macros.name: listofplates
macros.doc: Functions just like \listoffigures but prints a list of the plates.

macros.name: listofplates*
macros.doc: Functions just like \listoffigures but prints a list of the plates.

macros.name: ProcessPlates
macros.doc: At point of issue in document all the gathered plates thus far are printed.

macros.name: setplatename
macros.doc: Allows user to define the actual name used for the plates environment in the table of contents, caption, etc. The default is \setplatename{Plate}, alternately you could set it to \setplatename{Diagram}.

envs.name: plate
envs.doc: The user need only place these special figures in a plate environment instead of a figure environment and issue a command to print the plates at a chosen location in the document.
